claims_intro: Follow the official claim procedure laid down by the Directorate of Kerala State Lotteries.
claims_step_1: Retain Original Ticket: Keep the physical ticket safely. Do not tear, alter, write excessively, or laminate the ticket.
claims_step_2: Gazette Confirmation: Verify the winning number against the official Kerala Government Gazette publication.
claims_step_3: 30-Day Claim Rule: As per Kerala lottery rules, prize claims must be surrendered within 30 days from the draw date.
claims_step_4: Submission Counter: Claims up to ₹1,00,000 can be claimed through District Lottery Offices. Claims above ₹1,00,000 must be submitted to the Directorate of State Lotteries with valid identity and PAN documentation.
claims_deductions_notice: Official prize amounts are displayed. Applicable taxes (TDS) and agent commissions are subject to government statutory provisions.
disclaimer_text: This checker compares your ticket with the published lottery result stored for the selected draw. Always retain your original ticket and verify the result with the official Kerala State Lotteries publication before making a prize claim.
unauthorized_notice: This is an independent high-accuracy verification utility. It is not run by or affiliated with the Government of Kerala. No government logos are used.
